routes.name: R_LIFT_270: audit the original moment-free corrected lifts

C9000270.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 270 (Threshold and positive-energy bound states of the BFSS matrix model.; papers: The unique threshold bound state of the SU(N) BFSS model; Positive eigenvalues of the relative SU(2) BFSS Hamiltonian; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_LIFT_RESOLUTION_270.statement: Independently prove the original corrected-lift assertion or certify an obstruction to a literal load-bearing step; do not identify failure of a proof with falsity of the proposition.

C_LIFT_ALGEBRA_270.statement: Exact Clifford/Fierz coefficient identities for every real spinor, the undeformed and neutral squares, general trace cancellation, and the actual graded inverse support the full analytic proof; finite SU(3) probes are not its generalization argument.

C_SLICE_270.statement: lem:slice: exact spectral slice, j=|det ad(b_e)| and D=sqrt(h)E+D^s+R with the displayed gauge-spin and density terms.

C_NEUTRAL_270.statement: fast:one-plane-square and fast:neutral-square: central-torus neutrality yields a v-independent scalar-center square and unique even vacuum.

C_FAST_LINE_270.statement: lem:fast-line: nearby noncommuting blocks retain a rank-one neutral even kernel, uniform gap and prescribed finite oscillator-Sobolev derivative estimates.

C_COMPRESSION_270.statement: lem:diagonal-compression: zero Berry form and exact gauge-spin/density cancellation at scalar blocks, including every internal slow color.

C_MOMENT_FREE_270.statement: lift:separate-energy implies eq:kernel-scaled-estimate for actual internal L2 kernels with bounded physical cutoffs and no global moment assumptions.

C_CORRECTION_270.statement: lift:correction and lift:matrix-stability cancel the perpendicular residual with the actual graded inverse and leave vanishing correction outputs.

C_COMPATIBILITY_270.statement: lem:chart-compatibility glues both limits and transports with no extra scalar character.

C_LIFT_270.statement: prop:test-lifts with its original quantifiers: fixed m>=0, every unit spinor, every proper partition, compact collision-free center tests and arbitrary actual internal L2 kernels; both L2 limits and all stated finite-family and symmetry conclusions.

TH_INDEX_270.statement: prop:massive-index: the massive Fredholm index is p(N), using normal oscillators, slice compactness and vacuum recovery.

TH_PROFILES_270.statement: prop:profile-compactness and prop:profile-liminf identify proper-stratum profiles and the limiting center-charge lower bound.

TH_EXTERIOR_270.statement: prop:exterior-estimate and prof:full-exhaustion control escape and exhaust tight limiting norm.

TH_COUNT_270.statement: prop:massive-tightness, count:center-confinement, lem:large-coupling-gap and proper/full recovery combine index and profile counts, with smaller-block induction.

TH_MAIN_270.statement: thm:main: the relative SU(N) BFSS L2 zero-energy kernel has dimension one.

POS_FORM_270.statement: lem:form and lem:rotations: the closed physical form is one-half kinetic plus quartic V plus a fermion matrix bounded by C|x|; rotation sectors reduce H.

POS_BRANCH_270.statement: lem:branching, lem:slice and lem:oscillator exclude transverse levels n<=m when lambda_2>m+M.

POS_CONFINEMENT_270.statement: prop:confinement gives compact resolvent and zero kernel in sufficiently high second-weight physical rotation sectors.

POS_SECTORS_270.statement: lem:fermion-invariant and lem:large-sectors construct nonzero infinite-dimensional physical sectors with lambda_2 tending to infinity.

POS_MAIN_270.statement: thm:main: the specified physical relative SU(2) Hamiltonian has an orthonormal sequence of positive-energy L2 eigenvectors with energies tending to infinity.
